verdict.rationale: Google explicitly documents an official Agent SDK ('same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Antigravity, programmable in Python') supporting custom Python callables, MCP servers, skills, and multimedia inputs, which directly satisfies building against an official SDK. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of the SDK working as documented, and no public API reference/OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404s), so depth of documentation beyond marketing copy is unverified.
